Statutory Determination under Section 19 of the Land Reform Act, No. 1 of 1972

SINCE Liyana Arachchige Birthomius Gunathilake resided at 10th Mile Post, Uyilankulama has been delivered a statutory declaration under Section 18 of the Act According to the powers vested in the Land Reform Commission under Section 19 of the Act, Statutory Determination. has been done by this Commission determining the part that should be kept with him from the agricultural lands owned by the statutory lessee. The agricultural land parts which were allowed to be kept with the statutory lessee are mentioned in the schedule given below. PANDUKABAYA HARSHA KEERTINANDA, Attorney-at-law, Chairman, Land Reform Commission.
